description.zh:
车辆的动作类型，包含以下三种类型：

- **1**：进入
- **2**：停留
-  **3**：离开
description.en:
The action type of the vehicle. Valid values:

- **1**: entering
- **2**: staying
- **3**: leaving.

description.zh: IPC设备的检测框。您可调用[InvokeThingService](~~69584~~)查询检测框数量。其中**identifier**设置为**QueryAlgoTaskDetails**。
description.en: The detection box of the IPC device. You can call the [InvokeThingService](~~69584~~) operation to query the number of detection boxes. Set **identifier** to **QueryAlgoTaskDetails**.

description.zh: 查询范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序。
description.en: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1.

description.zh: 查询范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为20，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 20. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 车牌号码。最大支持输入15个字符。
description.en: The license plate number. The value can contain up to 15 characters.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation of IoT Platform to query this ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** serves as the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>.

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to view the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
单个阿里云账号调用改接口的每秒请求数（QOS）最大限制为10。  
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account that can invoke this operation is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
